verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same 320x50 banner. In both, the legal copy is a 4-line block at the left that is as large as the secondary text and competes with the headline. The 'LONGEST DAY SALE' badge has shrunk to an illegible sliver tucked under the headline and almost touching it. The product can and logo are tiny smudges. In B the logo/sun sits slightly more cramped at the top edge, so A is marginally cleaner. Neither keeps the original's hierarchy.
